newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns A3 to two JVC domestic CBs.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns A3 to two JVC domestic CBs.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday that it had assigned an A3 senior unsecured debt rating to two domestic convertible bonds issued by Victor Co of Japan Ltd (JVC)
The bonds are 20 billion yen worth of convertibles due 2002 and 20 billion yen worth of convertibles due 2005, it said in a statement.

The rating is based on Moody's expectation that JVC management's restructuring programme will result in growing profitability and improved debt protection measures over the long term, the rating agency said.

The rating also reflects Moody's belief that the growth of the company's mainstay business, consumer audio/visual products, will remain sluggish over the intermediate term and that JVC will continue to face intensified global competition and pricing pressure.
